visual_anatomy.title: A compact black headline and small subtitle introduce a catalogue of thirteen ways to express the same simple three-step framework.
visual_anatomy.layout: Thirteen numbered, equal-sized tiles form a 4-4-5 gallery. Each tile uses a different circular, layered, table-like, or connector configuration while preserving the same abstract three-step labels.
visual_anatomy.reading_order: Title and premise → scan the numbered tile gallery from left to right and top to bottom → compare which geometry makes the same logic easiest to see.
visual_anatomy.typography: Simple light sans title and subtitle; very small neutral labels inside diagrams; discreet tile numbers in the upper corners.
visual_anatomy.colour: A rotating set of pastel lavender, pink, aqua, blue, and mint tile grounds; dark fine-line diagrams and pale white/grey layered objects.
visual_anatomy.surface: Thirteen flat framed samples, each with thin outlines, pale depth/shadow on circular forms, and very little chrome outside the tiles.
visual_anatomy.modules: One catalogue header plus thirteen small multiples that hold constant the underlying three-step content while changing the visual grammar.
visual_anatomy.density: High at thumbnail scale but intentionally index-like: detail belongs inside each small multiple, not in one long explanatory paragraph.

motion.observed_state_change: All thirteen small multiples are present in each sample. Small circular waypoint markers change position around arcs, rings, stacked forms, and connector endpoints; the catalogue itself remains fixed and readable.
motion.motion_job: Suggest that the same conceptual route can travel through several diagram grammars without forcing the reader to wait for the catalogue to become usable.
motion.limitation: The samples establish moving waypoint positions within the fixed catalogue, not a frame-by-frame reconstruction of timing or platform playback.

transferable_mechanism.reader_job: Compare several possible visual grammars for the same underlying relationship before selecting the clearest one.
transferable_mechanism.argument_shape: Small-multiple visual-language catalogue with a constant abstract input.
transferable_mechanism.mechanism: Hold the conceptual payload constant across a bounded set of miniatures, vary one representational decision at a time, and number the alternatives for reference in later discussion.
transferable_mechanism.use_condition: Use when the reader benefits from choosing a representation and every small multiple tests a real visual grammar; do not build a decorative template dump.

anti_copy_boundary: Do not reuse the one-framework-to-thirteen concept, three-step labels, 4-4-5 tile catalogue, circular mini-diagram designs, exact pastel tiling, title wording, or waypoint motion.

claim_boundary.note: No matching caption was supplied. The asset is a visual-language catalogue and contains no native performance metric; it does not validate any outcome from choosing one diagram over another.
